newsitem.title: QATAR: First vessels for Qatari LNG ready in fourth quart.
newsitem.headline: First vessels for Qatari LNG ready in fourth quart.

text.p: Naming ceremonies for Qatar's first liquefied natural gas (LNG) tankers to export gas from the Gulf Arab state will take place at Japanese dockyards in October and November, a Qatari oil source said on Sunday.

The 135,000 cubic metre capacity Al Zubarah will be launched at the Chiba dockyard on October 4 and Al Khor at Nagasaki on November 1 to enable exports of Qatari LNG from the six million tonnes a year capacity Qatargas project starting in December.
The two are the first of ten gas carrying vessels that will be delivered to Qatar over the next four years.
